subject.title: feat(canvas): export widgets as PNG — copy or download from the card menu

question: Should OpenClaw ship PNG copy/download actions as a built-in Canvas widget-card capability after final UI-flow proof, rather than keep widgets view-only?
rationale: This PR adds a new user-facing export workflow and a permanent sandbox bridge; correctness evidence does not decide whether that product surface and its fallback behavior are the intended core experience.

options.title: Approve the built-in export workflow
options.body: Accept the widget-card action menu after redacted proof shows real web-chat copy and download behavior on the final head.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep download-only or otherwise reduce the initial surface if clipboard behavior and browser support are not desired as a core promise.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR if Canvas widget export should instead be designed through a different product boundary or release plan.

recommendation.title: Approve the built-in export workflow
recommendation.body: Accept the widget-card action menu after redacted proof shows real web-chat copy and download behavior on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: They currently own the implementation and can provide the missing final-path proof, while a web-UI owner should supply the acceptance decision.
